clips.title: The story
paras: At Darkspear Strand, the tribe’s refuge begins on Durotar’s southern coast. The trolls came ashore after exile from the Echo Isles and built Sen'jin Village nearby under Vol'jin’s leadership.

The Darkspear trolls came ashore here after losing the Echo Isles. When witch doctor Zalazane seized their home, survivors crossed the narrow waters and landed on this coast. They gathered just yards inland rather than scatter into Durotar’s hostile red wastes, and built Sen'jin Village. The strand looks across the surf toward the islands they still hope to reclaim.
